sections.text_helper: Section 20.4.1 "DLYB control register (DLYB_CR)" in chapter 20 (Delay block (DLYB)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 558.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x000
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:2 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 1 SEN: Sampler length enable bit
0: Sampler length and register access to UNIT[6:0] and SEL[3:0] disabled, output clock
enabled.
1: Sampler length and register access to UNIT[6:0] and SEL[3:0] enabled, output clock
disabled.
Bit 0 DEN: Delay block enable bit
0: DLYB disabled.
1: DLYB enabled.

fields.name: Res.
fields.description: Reserved, must be kept at reset value.

fields.name: SEN
fields.description: Sampler length enable bit enabled. disabled.
